title.zh: v2.0.35 钢琴卷帘多小节全域网格质感重塑与琶音展开大师组：彻底消除黑屏死区、全半音阶白黑键分道底纹、调式根音金光徽标、一键解除循环全轨展开、和弦升降序琶音展开（Arp ▲/▼）与127极限力度动态标尺
title.en: v2.0.35 Piano Roll Unified Professional DAW Grid & Multi-Note Arpeggiator Suite: Blackout dead-zone elimination across all bars, natural/accidental key lane shading, scale root gold watermark badges, 1-click loop extension, multi-note arpeggiator (Arp ▲/▼), and 127 fff velocity dynamic markers

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘全小节网格质感重塑（Unified Professional DAW Grid Across All Bars）**：彻底修复多小节工程中首小节后网格反差断层、暗沉黑斑与线条不可见的视觉缺陷。网格底衬采用专业工作室海军深石板色调（#131624 与 #181c2e 优雅微反差交替），全半音阶自然白键行配备细腻透光层、半音黑键行采用经典钢琴黑曜石暗轨；调式根音行赋予温润金阳微光（rgba(245,158,11,0.13)）与小节起始「ROOT」金色水印徽标；16分音符与4分音符拍线贯穿全部小节，彻底消除空洞黑斑。
highlights.en: **Unified Professional DAW Grid Across All Bars**: Completely resolved the visual disparity where bars past Bar 1 appeared as an illegible black void. The grid canvas now features a sleek dark studio slate palette (#131624 and #181c2e subtle bar alternation), natural white key lanes with luminous highlights, and obsidian black key gutter rows. Scale root rows are illuminated with warm amber gradients and "ROOT" gold watermark badges, while crisp 16th and beat dividers span a…

highlights.zh: **和弦升降序琶音即时展开（Multi-Note Arpeggiator Suite / Arp ▲ & Arp ▼）**：在 Deck 2 和弦编配区全新引入「琶音 ▲ (Arp ▲)」与「琶音 ▼ (Arp ▼)」工具。在网格中框选或点选任意复合和弦后，一键自动将静态叠音在时间线上按音高升序或降序分解平铺为连续步进琶音流水线条，并保持适当时值与独立编辑选区，极大解放键盘琶音与流水旋律的编曲生产力。
highlights.en: **Multi-Note Arpeggiator Suite (Arp ▲ & Arp ▼)**: Introduced dedicated "Arp ▲" and "Arp ▼" buttons in Deck 2. Selecting any chord stack and clicking an Arp button instantly unrolls block chords chronologically across consecutive steps in ascending or descending pitch order, turning static chords into fluid, rhythmic arpeggio runs with full undo support.

highlights.zh: **一键解除循环限制全轨展开（1-Click Track Loop Extension）**：针对独立循环长度短于工程总长的音轨，在网格循环导轨与标尺中增加直达交互标牌「展开全轨 (Extend Track)」。创作者无需反复进入设置或手动对齐，轻点即可将该轨循环长度安全扩充至工程全长，解锁全部小节的直接绘制与旋律发展。
highlights.en: **1-Click Track Loop Extension**: For tracks whose loop length was clamped below the project's total step count, an interactive "Extend Track" button is embedded in the loop boundary HUD. Creators can immediately expand the track loop to match the full song length with one click, unlocking full multi-bar sequencing freedom.
